title: DBZ Budokai 3 HD Collection
description: Static recompilation (ReXGlue) of Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3 HD Collection (Xbox 360) for Windows, with a custom launcher, dual-region US/EU core, per-entry AFS mod system and model swap/texture tools. No game data is included: bring your own default.xex + us/eu asset folders from the disc.
